## What happened?

## Diagnostic report

**Review and remove any private information before posting publicly. Do not upload serial numbers, hardware UUIDs, credentials, email addresses or personal details.**

## Test result (if you installed experimentally)

- Did the keyboard LEDs actually turn on or off?
- Did keyboard brightness change?
- Did the original Touch Bar illumination buttons work while the menu bar menu was **closed**?
- Did they work while it was **open**?

Thanks for helping us improve T2 MacBook compatibility!
